dashboard.label: Setup
dashboard.description: Admin-only. How to connect the collector and check that it works.

html.p: Splunk Cloud apps can't create indexes. Create dmx_inventory (event index) in Settings > Indexes or with ACS: acs indexes create --name dmx_inventory --data-type event.

Create a token for a user whose role can read Ingest Processor configuration (Settings > Tokens). Store it in this app's secret storage from a machine allowed to reach the stack's management port (8089, see the ACS IP allow list for search-api):

To rotate it, POST the new value to .../storage/passwords/dmx_inventory:dmx_service_account: with -d password=.... The token never appears in search results or logs. If no token is stored, the collector uses the session of whoever runs it (fine for a first test as sc_admin).
Run | dmxcollect dry_run=t in Search. You should see one row per pipeline, destination and dataset. An error column means the endpoint, token or role needs attention; the message says which.

Run | dmxcollect, then enable the DMX Inventory - Collect scheduled search (Settings > Searches, reports, and alerts). Optionally enable the change, stale-collection and schema-drift alerts after adding an alert action.

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local /servicesNS/nobody/dmx_inventory/storage/passwords | search realm="dmx_inventory" | table username realm eai:acl.app updated
`dmx_index` sourcetype=dmx:collector | table _time status auth_mode duration_ms host reason
